content:
alice: Heads-up — bringing new cross-encoder reranker v2 into the eval harness. Quick summary: float32 baseline vs int8 quantized variant. Seeing ~0.7% NDCG drop overall but MRR variance spiking on a small slice of queries (long context + conversational history). Anyone seen similar slice-wise effects?

ben: can you paste the eval command + sample failing query? :eyes:

alice: sure — run I used:
```
./eval_harness --model rerank-cross-v2 --datasets webqa,helpdesk,docs --metrics ndcg@10,mrr --quantize int8 --seed 42 --group-by query_head
```
Sample query (truncated): "how do i rotate keys without downtime when connecting services that use sts tokens?" — long doc hits tokenization boundary.

carmen: hmm long-docs often lose KV cache precision under PTQ-like quantization. did you try matching sequence-length buckets for train/eval?

alice: not yet. my stratified sample was random over the whole set. I can rerun with length buckets. also noticed the failure cluster has a heavy presence of FAQ-style queries (short queries, long canonical docs) — weird.

dave: two quick checks: 1) run bootstrap CI on the slice to confirm significance, 2) compare cross-encoder vs two-stage (bi-encoder + cross re-rank) to see if reranker is the issue or upstream candidates.

eval-bot: bootstrap CI finished for slice 'long-docs' — delta MRR = -0.015 (95% CI [-0.027, -0.003]) — likely significant :warning:

ben: ok that's borderline. If it's concentrated in a small head, we can consider per-query calibration (score rescaling) or masked attention fallback for long docs.

alice: re-run plan: 1) stratified by length buckets (0-256,256-1024,1024+), 2) rerun quantize with per-tensor scale vs per-channel, 3) produce per-query head ndcg/mrr histograms. I can push results tomorrow.

carmen: add a check to log tokenizer splits for failing docs — might be an off-by-one in padding.

dave: also capture candidate pool quality (recall@100) — if candidate recall drops under int8 that could explain reranker hit.

alice: good point. adding recall@100 to the next run. thanks all :heart:

ben: if you want I can prototype a tiny calibration shim: map scores -> logit space and temperature-scale per head. quick to try.

alice: please do. will attach failing query ids in the thread once i have the runs.

eval-bot: run queued: build/ci-eval/1698123456-rerank-cross-v2-int8-stratified
